says: In today's CI, the law 'scenario: P8 installed callbacks survive a ready-observed SIGKILL before final JSON, while normal and timed-out verdicts stay real' failed on a scheduled branch proof leg: after the SIGKILL, Vitest's final JSON already existed, so the timing read was 'read' where the law expects 'unavailable'. The kill races the child's own final write.
proof: Branch proof run https://github.com/kamp-us/tea-fabrika/actions/runs/44315669639, leg changed (3), job 134841612997, at a2217352223acf0e6754240e1dd2a07dfbdd0e3f: `AssertionError: expected 'read' to be 'unavailable'` at progress-reporter.integration.test.ts:356:31; 1 failed, 467 passed in that leg. The branch (ticket 1161) does not touch the file or what it imports; PR 1567 reports the same law green on disposable runs 44108835179 and 44117144227.
cost: Any scheduled run that reaches this file, main's full run included, can go red with no fault in the change; a rerun would hide it, which 0036 forbids.
